## Purpose and Scopesvg image

The `buildcontext` command packages a directory (or multiple directories/files) into a single Markdown context file. This creates a portable, text-based representation of an entire project that can be easily shared, backed up, or provided to AI models for code analysis and generation.

This page documents the Markdown workflow variant of the build command. For HTML output, see [buildcontexthtml](/ray0404/Contexter/5.1.2-buildcontexthtml). For reconstructing projects from context files, see [reconstructor](/ray0404/Contexter/5.2.1-reconstructor).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md24](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L24-L24) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py41](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L41-L41)

---

## Command Syntaxsvg image

**Entry Point:** The command maps to `context_builder.main()` via setuptools console script.

| Component | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `output_file` | Positional argument (required) | Path to the output Markdown file |
| `paths` | Positional arguments (one or more) | File or directory paths to include in the context |
| `--exclude` | Optional flag (repeatable) | Glob patterns for files/directories to exclude |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py50-55](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L50-L55) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py41](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L41-L41)

---

## Arguments and Optionssvg image

### output\_filesvg image

The destination Markdown file where the combined context will be written. The file will be created or overwritten if it exists.

**Example:** `project_context.md`, `output/my_project.md`

### pathssvg image

One or more paths to process. Can be:

- **Individual files**: Specific files to include
- **Directories**: Recursively processed, including all non-excluded files
- **Mixed**: Combination of files and directories

Paths are normalized using `os.path.normpath()` and checked for existence before processing.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L53-L53) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py61-69](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L61-L69)

### --excludesvg image

Additional exclusion patterns beyond the defaults. Can be specified multiple times. Uses `fnmatch` pattern matching.

**Default Exclusions (from `contexter_utils.DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS`):**

- `.git`, `.gitignore`
- `node_modules`, `venv`, `__pycache__`
- `*.pyc`, `*.pyo`, `*.pyd`
- `.DS_Store`
- Other common development artifacts

**Usage Example:**

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py54](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L54-L54) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py57](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L57-L57) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py8](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L8-L8)

## Processing Flowsvg image

### Main Execution Pathsvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py50-71](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L50-L71)

### Recursive Path Processingsvg image

The `process_path_for_md()` function handles the recursive traversal and file writing logic:

**Key Implementation Details:**

- **Duplicate Prevention:** Uses a `processed_files` set to track normalized paths and avoid processing the same file twice
- **Top-level Tree:** Generates directory tree structure only for the first directory processed (not for nested directories)
- **Sorted Output:** Directories and files are sorted alphabetically for consistent output
- **Recursive Walking:** Uses `os.walk()` with `topdown=True` to enable in-place directory filtering

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py11-48](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L48)

---

## Output Format Specificationsvg image

The generated Markdown file follows a structured format that can be parsed by `reconstructor`:

### Directory Structure Sectionsvg image

For each top-level directory, a tree structure is generated:

project\_name/
├── src/
│ ├── main.py
│ └── utils.py
├── tests/
│ └── test\_main.py
└── README.md

```px-2
```

**Function:** `generate_file_tree()` from `contexter_utils`

### File Entry Format

Each non-binary file is represented as:

```markdown
--- FILE: path/to/file.py ---

````python
# File contents here
def hello():
    print("Hello, World!")
```

```px-2
**Components:**
- **File Header:** `--- FILE: {normalized_path} ---` (surrounded by blank lines)
- **Code Fence:** Triple backticks with language identifier
- **Content:** Stripped file content (leading/trailing whitespace removed)

### Binary File Marker

Binary files are noted but not included:

```markdown
--- SKIPPED (BINARY): path/to/image.png ---
```

**Detection:** Uses `is_binary()` from `contexter_utils` which checks for null bytes in the first 8KB

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py23-25](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L23-L25) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py44-45](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L44-L45) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py38](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L38-L38)

## Language Detectionsvg image

The command automatically detects file languages for syntax highlighting in the output:

**Supported Languages (partial list from `contexter_utils`):**

- `.py` → `python`
- `.js` → `javascript`
- `.java` → `java`
- `.cpp`, `.cc` → `cpp`
- `.md` → `markdown`
- `.json` → `json`
- `.yaml`, `.yml` → `yaml`
- And many more...

**Function:** `get_language_from_path()` from `contexter_utils`

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py43](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L43-L43) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py70-120](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py#L70-L120)

### Example 1: Package a Single Directorysvg image

**Result:** All files in `./src` (recursively) are packaged into `my_project.md`, excluding default patterns.

### Example 2: Multiple Pathssvg image

**Result:** Contents of `src/` and `docs/` directories plus the `README.md` file are combined.

### Example 3: Custom Exclusionssvg image

**Result:** Project packaged with additional exclusions for log files, temp files, and draft files.

### Example 4: Absolute Pathssvg image

## Console Outputsvg image

During execution, `buildcontext` provides real-time progress feedback:

| Symbol | Message Type | Example |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 📂 | Directory processing | `📂 Processing directory: ./src` |
| ✅ | File processed | `✅ Processed: src/main.py` |
| ⚫ | Binary skipped | `⚫ Skipping (binary): image.png` |
| ⚠️ | Path not found | `⚠️ Warning: Path not found, skipping: ./missing` |
| ❌ | Read error | `❌ Error reading file src/corrupt.txt: ...` |
| 🎉 | Success | `🎉 Success! All paths processed into 'output.md'.` |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py20](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L20-L20) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py46](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L46-L46) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py37](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L37-L37) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py64](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L64-L64) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py48](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L48-L48) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py71](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L71-L71)

## Implementation Detailssvg image

### File Processing Statesvg image

The command maintains state during execution to prevent duplicate processing:

**Data Structure:** `processed_files` is a Python `set` containing normalized path strings.

**Purpose:** Prevents infinite loops from symlinks and avoids duplicate content when paths overlap.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py58](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L58-L58) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py13-16](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L13-L16)

### Error Handlingsvg image

The command implements graceful error handling:

1. **Missing Paths:** Non-existent paths trigger a warning but don't halt execution
2. **Read Errors:** File read failures are caught, logged, and skipped
3. **Binary Files:** Detected and skipped with a marker in the output
4. **Encoding Errors:** Files are read with `errors='ignore'` to handle non-UTF-8 content

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py63-65](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L63-L65) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py47-48](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L47-L48) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py36-38](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L36-L38) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py41](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L41-L41)

## Key Functions and Data Flowsvg image

### Core Function: process\_path\_for\_md()svg image

**Parameters:**

- `path` (str): File or directory path to process
- `outfile` (file object): Open file handle for writing output
- `exclude_patterns` (list): Glob patterns for exclusion
- `processed_files` (set): Set of already-processed normalized paths

**Behavior:**

1. Normalizes the path with `os.path.normpath()`
2. Checks for duplicates in `processed_files`
3. For directories:
   - Generates tree structure (if top-level)
   - Walks directory recursively with `os.walk()`
   - Filters directories and files against exclusion patterns
   - Sorts for consistent output
   - Recursively processes each file
4. For files:
   - Checks if binary with `is_binary()`
   - Reads content with UTF-8 encoding
   - Detects language with `get_language_from_path()`
   - Writes formatted file entry

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py11-48](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L48)

### Core Function: main()svg image

**Flow:**

1. Parse command-line arguments with `argparse`
2. Combine default and custom exclusion patterns
3. Initialize `processed_files` set
4. Open output file for writing
5. Iterate through input paths:
   - Normalize path
   - Check existence
   - Check exclusion patterns
   - Call `process_path_for_md()` for valid paths
6. Print success message

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py50-71](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L50-L71)

---

## Related Utilities from contexter\_utilssvg image

The `buildcontext` command relies heavily on shared utilities:

| Function | Purpose | Usage in buildcontext |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS` | List of default exclusion patterns | Combined with user-specified patterns |
| `is_binary(path)` | Detects binary files | Skip binary files or mark them as skipped |
| `generate_file_tree(path, exclude)` | Creates ASCII directory tree | Generate tree structure for directories |
| `get_language_from_path(path)` | Maps file extension to language | Set code fence language identifier |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py7-9](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L7-L9) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L36-L36) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py24](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L24-L24) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py43](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L43-L43)

## Performance Considerationssvg image

### Time Complexitysvg image

- **File Discovery:** O(n) where n = total files in all input paths
- **Exclusion Filtering:** O(n × p) where p = number of exclusion patterns
- **Duplicate Checking:** O(1) average case (set lookup)
- **File Reading:** O(n × s) where s = average file size

### Memory Usagesvg image

- **processed\_files set:** O(n) where n = number of unique paths
- **File content buffering:** One file read into memory at a time
- **Output buffering:** Controlled by Python's file I/O buffering

### Optimization Featuressvg image

1. **Incremental Writing:** Files are written to output immediately, not buffered in memory
2. **Early Exclusion:** Directories matching exclusion patterns are pruned during `os.walk()`
3. **Duplicate Prevention:** Set-based tracking prevents reprocessing
4. **Binary Detection:** Fast null-byte check in first 8KB prevents full read of large binaries

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py29-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L29-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py13-16](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L13-L16) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py36](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L36-L36)
